description: Individual expandable panel within a TmAccordion, with a clickable header showing title, optional subtitle, icon, and chevron indicator. Supports keyboard navigation and disabled state. The expansion state is two-way bindable (@bind-IsExpanded); inside an accordion with ExpandedKeys the item is group-controlled through its Key.

parameters.name: IsExpanded
parameters.description: Whether this item is expanded. Never assigned inside the component: uncontrolled (no IsExpandedChanged) it seeds the internal state and is re-applied only when the host changes the value; controlled (@bind-IsExpanded) the parameter is the single source of truth. Ignored while the parent accordion's ExpandedKeys owns the item.

parameters.name: IsExpandedChanged
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests an expansion change (click / Enter / Space) — add it (or @bind-IsExpanded) to take control of the state. Not raised for a disabled item or under group control (ExpandedKeysChanged reports those changes).

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description: Stable identity of the item for group control and URL sync. When the parent TmAccordion has a non-null ExpandedKeys, every keyed item's expansion is owned by the accordion host. Keys compare ordinally (case-sensitive); duplicate Keys share one state. Null (default) leaves the item self-managed.
